text:
Platinum Price in 2018
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2018, the LBMA platinum price fell 21.4% between 2018-01-31 ($1,003) and 2018-12-28 ($788). The highest sampled price was $1,003 in January and the lowest was $788 in December. The mean of these observations was $871. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
